text:
maria: Heads-up: Planning a thermostat-style cutover for api/runtime/console/router tonight 23:30 UTC. Goal: gradual thermostat ramp (5 -> 20 -> 60 -> 100) with safety holdpoints. Anyone cannot make it?
priya: runtime here. I'll pin runtime-image=rwinf:2026.03 to dedicated pools during window. Will also set eviction-throttle at 12% hard cutoff.
jamie: router here. I'll manage header swap + keep a quick rollback recipe. I want a 3-min sustained >250ms P95 trigger for hold.
lin: console ok. I'll publish notes to /release-notes/pending and add a short runbook excerpt for oncall.
deploybot: deploybot: starting phase alpha: runtime image=rwinf:2026.03 pct=5 wave=thermostat ts=1829999100
opsbot: perf-sample: runtime p95=102ms errors=0.2% evictions=0.6% (baseline)
maria: Quick explicit owners: runtime/infra rollback = priya, router rollback = jamie, console/UI rollback = lin. If cross-service incident, maria will coordinate escalation.
priya: smoke: `curl -fsS https://staging.api/health | jq .` -> {
  "status": "ok"
} (small sample)
jamie: routing split cmd: `routerctl split apply --svc api --tag rwinf-202603 --pct 5`
lin: release-notes snippet added + rollback commands. pinged #oncall.
deploybot: deploybot: alpha health ok=210 fail=1 p95=110ms pct=5 ts=1829999200
opsbot: watch: GC pauses spiked in one pod (120ms) — tracking. not yet breaching throttle.
maria: runbook thermostat policy: holdpoints at each step for 10m, run quick smoke evals, health gates = {errors<1%, p95<250ms, evictions<10%}. Breach -> auto-pause.
priya: noted. I've also prepared `infractl pin-pool --pool=dedicated-runtime --image=rwinf:2026.03` and `infractl unpin --image=rwinf:2026.02` ready.
jamie: adding router rollback CLI to notes: `routerctl split apply --svc api --pct 0 --tag rwinf-202603 && routerctl split apply --svc api --pct 100 --tag rwinf-202602`
lin: console rollback note: `consolectl deploy --rollback-to v202602 --dry-run` added.
deploybot: deploybot: ramp to 20% complete ts=1829999400 status=green
opsbot: perf-update: p95=130ms errors=0.3% evictions=1.4% after 20% ramp
maria: manual check: all green -> proceed to 60%? reply with ack.
priya: ack from runtime. Monitoring KV eviction closely.
jamie: ack from router. header-swap flag held until 60% success.
lin: ack from console. publishing final release note on success.
deploybot: deploybot: ramp to 60% complete ts=1829999560 status=green
opsbot: perf-update: p95=180ms errors=0.45% evictions=2.1%
maria: ok final ramp to 100% in 15m if stable. who will close the change window?
lin: I'll publish final notes and close window after 1h stable. URL -> https://internal/release-notes/1829999001
priya: runtime will watch for 30m post full ramp, ready to unpin and rollback. rollback command (infra): `infractl unpin --pool=dedicated-runtime --image=rwinf:2026.03 && infractl deploy --image=rwinf:2026.02`
jamie: router on standby for immediate split-back if p95>250ms sustained 3x1m. command above.
deploybot: deploybot: final ramp -> 100% ts=1829999730 status=green
opsbot: 30m post-ramp check: p95=165ms errors=0.35% evictions=1.8%
maria: nice work team. recording owners + commands in runbook. If any threshold breaches, call respective rollback owner and paste the exact CLI. :tada:
